We need to get the action recognized. Possibly the issue is that we need to include the tags exactly with no extra whitespace before them, and ensure JSON is valid. Also need to ensure we don't include ellipsis. Use actual values.

Let's construct:

<thought>We will apply the first template (reaction_id 1237522) to the target molecule to get precursors.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]","template_id":1237522}</action_input>

Make sure no leading spaces.
